meta.title: Keep agent edits from reloading the page: proposed

frontend.label: UI step where the work started

nodes.label: Vite reloads this page
nodes.explanation: With chat on, a page whose dev server's client loaded (today's detection of Bun, Next.js, Vite and webpack, read again as resources and elements arrive) shows the notice beside the bar: 'Vite reloads this page when files change' / 'Agent edits can reload it while you work.' with Disable Reloads and Dismiss (SURF-1). Visible text says reloads, never hot reloading (WORD-1). Disable Reloads keeps its label (O2), and its accessible description says an agent receives the request: 'Opens a request for Claude Code to turn off reloads in this worktree; nothing is sent until you press Send' (REV-5). The card has no live role, so this standing notice is never announced on load, and it sits in FB-8's third group, newest first (FB-9, FB-8; keyboard-and-screen-reader-02, notices-and-feedback's, related). Collapsed, its one-line form opens the same popover (SURF-8); under the page's modal dialog it moves inside with the notice stack (SURF-11); toolbar-shell places both (chat-compose-04, toolbar-shell-01, toolbar-shell-07, related). Keys: Alt+Ctrl+B, then Tab or Shift+Tab (KEY-3, KEY-4, KEY-5). Resolves the switch-like label of reload-and-agents-01.

Reuses: client detection, four dev servers

nodes.label: Review the request
nodes.explanation: Disable Reloads sends nothing: it opens a non-modal popover anchored to the notice, 'Ask Claude Code to turn off reloads?', every time, because the editable request is the question (SURF-2, REV-1, REV-5, O2, WORD-10). It names 'Claude Code · Haiku 4.5 · starts a new conversation', with each open conversation of this worktree as a radio option and new selected (SEL-8, O27); the approval line, 'Never asks: Claude Code runs commands and edits without approval' when the CLI never asks (O13); the fixed mode line 'This worktree (live) · main ~/acme · no new worktree, commit or merge' (O1, SEL-4); and the request for the detected server, focused: Vite's server.hmr: false or Bun's development: { hmr: false }, telling the agent not to edit devhost.toml (O26); for Next.js, 'devhost knows no verified switch' above a generic request (O25). With the hold off it offers Hold Reloads. Enter inserts a line break and Send has no key (KEY-9); Escape, Cancel, Tab out or a click outside send nothing and return focus (REV-4, KEY-6, KEY-7, KEY-8). Resolves the unseen, generic one-click send of reload-and-agents-01.

sources.label: Replaces: one click opens chat and sends
Replaces: generic request naming no setting
Replaces: sent as soon as chat is ready

nodes.label: Send in live mode
nodes.explanation: Send sends the text as edited, with no page context: POST /__devhost__/chat/sessions when it starts a conversation, then the chat socket's send with mode: 'live' and its commandId, into the conversation the popover named (O27, CC-10). Before a new conversation starts beside an agent chat did not start, Send expands in place into the second-agent question with Cancel focused, which keeps the request unsent (REV-3, REV-4, CC-14). The message carries the live mode's instructions, never the worktree, commit and merge workflow (O1, O19), and shows in its conversation with 'Mode: This worktree (live) · main ~/acme' and 'Added by devhost' (WORD-10, UNDO-8; agent-chat's). The agent edits vite.config.ts through its own approvals, which devhost never answers (REV-9). Chat does not open by itself (FB-1). The request is one operation whose ID is its commandId, kept on the server with its delivery record and read by every browser of the stack (ACT-1, CC-38, CC-40); a delivery unconfirmed within 45 s reads 'Delivery unconfirmed' and is never resent (REV-12). Resolves the worktree prompt and the unnamed conversation of reload-and-agents-01.

sources.label: Replaces: joins a running conversation
Reuses: appends instructions to each send
Replaces: worktree, commit and merge prompt

nodes.label: Request sent · working
nodes.explanation: The popover closes and the notice keeps its slot with the request's progress, focus on its sentence: 'Request sent to Claude Code · working · 40 s', the time updated outside any live region, with Open Conversation (FB-5, FB-1, FB-9, KEY-6). When the agent asks, it reads 'Claude Code is waiting for you · Edit vite.config.ts?', rises to FB-8's first group, is announced once, and Answer opens docked chat on that conversation's decision card in one activation (REV-9, SURF-8, ACT-7). The request is followed in its own conversation, through the session list of every worktree of the stack and its delivery records (CC-38, CC-40), whatever conversation chat shows, after New Conversation or a switch, and whatever Chat Directory a development build selects; it survives reloads and closed tabs. Reloads its edits cause wait on Reload blocked. While pending it takes Disable Reloads' place, so no second request starts. Stop Turn ends it as 'Request stopped by you after 29 s' (FAIL-5). Resolves reload-and-agents-08 and reload-and-agents-11 (the request settled only while its conversation was open and the directory was Project).

sources.label: Replaces: notice hidden while a request runs
Replaces: settles only in the open conversation
Replaces: settle check run by the open chat

nodes.label: Request done
nodes.explanation: When the turn ends, the slot shows the result in place of Disable Reloads, announced once, in words devhost observed (FB-5, O24, WORD-4): 'Request done: Claude Code changed vite.config.ts · Vite's client still loads until web restarts · 1 min 12 s' with Restart web leading, then Show Changes and Open Conversation (MENU-5, SEL-3). It stays until web restarts or the person dismisses it (FB-6); devhost restarts nothing by itself. A turn that changed no file reads 'Claude Code changed no file · 48 s'; a manifest edit adds 'also changed devhost.toml', whose own reload names what it restarted (FB-3, O26). Show Changes opens a popover, 'Changed 1 file: vite.config.ts · not committed', with Copy Reverse Patch and Ask to Undo, which puts the undo request into that conversation's composer unsent, and the agent's reply on turning reloads back on (UNDO-5, O22). There is no Undo: devhost cannot take back an agent's edit, so the result names its way back. The stack's log and terminal print one outcome line (FB-7, FB-10, FB-11). Resolves reload-and-agents-02 (the notice came back word for word, naming neither the request nor the restart it needed).

sources.label: Replaces: settling clears the request record

nodes.label: Restart web
nodes.explanation: Restart web is the Services panel's restart of the page's service, naming its one target in its label and accessible description (SEL-1, SEL-3): the same restart-service request with an operationId (ACT-1, CC-37). Its progress and outcome show in the result's slot, 'Restarting web… 3 s', then 'Restarted web · 2.6 s' (FB-1, FB-2, WORD-4). While Restart Stack runs it is unavailable but focusable, with 'Restart Stack is running · 3 of 6 started'; while another service restarts it queues (HOLD-3, SEL-7); while web's worktree is deleted it gives that worktree's reason (HOLD-4); with devhost.toml rejected it stays available, 'uses the accepted manifest; devhost.toml line 12 is not applied' (HOLD-6); on a lost stream it is unavailable with 'Lost connection to devhost; retrying' and web reads unknown, never down (HOLD-2, ACT-5). With Hold Reloads on, the reload Vite asks for after its restart is held and joins Reload blocked. It applies the restart reload-and-agents-02 left unsaid.

sources.label: Reuses: POST restart-service with the names

nodes.label: Hold Reloads · 2 held
nodes.explanation: The way without an agent: Hold Reloads is on by default and holds every script reload of the page through the Navigation API, the dev server's and the app's own location.reload(), a documented limitation (owner rule); the browser's refresh and devhost's own reloads go through, and hot updates are never held. On the bar it is an arrow stop named 'Hold Reloads, on, 2 held' (KEY-4); its popover holds the switch with its reach sentence (SEL-11), the held count with Reload Now, Show Reload Notice while the notice is dismissed (UNDO-3) and 'This browser, for this stack and page origin' (CC-9); Escape, Tab past its last control or a click outside close it and return focus (KEY-6, KEY-7). devhost's own reload lets exactly one navigation through, so after Stay at a page's 'Leave site?' prompt the hold holds again and Reload blocked keeps its count. The hold runs whatever segment shows and keeps its look in forced colors: toolbar-shell's (toolbar-shell-03, keyboard-and-screen-reader-04, related). Resolves reload-and-agents-07 (after Stay, the hold let every later reload through while it still showed on).

sources.label: Replaces: toggle with one label, aria-pressed
Reuses: Hold Reloads on by default
Replaces: own-reload flag never cleared

nodes.label: Reload blocked · 2 held
nodes.explanation: Reload blocked counts every held reload and says what devhost knows: 'Reload blocked · 2 reloads held since 14:02', 'web restarted at 14:05', and the files the published changed mark names under the page's service's watch paths, 'Changed: src/Button.tsx, vite.config.ts', or 'No watched file of web changed' (SEL-3, ACT-8, SEL-2), with Reload Now and Dismiss; a reverted edit leaves the list. When every named file was applied in place by a hot update the page saw and web has not restarted since the load, it reads 'Already current: Vite applied src/Button.tsx in place' and ends by itself, leaving its log line (ACT-7); services-panel draws the same note beside the changed mark. It never claims more. Reload Now is devhost's own reload (UNDO-2). It sits in FB-8's third group, and toolbar-shell keeps it visible collapsed, beside docked chat and inside the page's modal dialog (toolbar-shell-01, chat-compose-04, toolbar-shell-07, related). Resolves the reload-control slice of journey-agent-fix-03, with its duplicate stack-scale-08; the content-based changed mark is services-panel's (services-panel-2-01, related).

sources.label: Reuses: holds script reloads, Navigation API
Replaces: fixed copy with no count or cause

nodes.label: Reloads are off
nodes.explanation: Reload Now applies the held reloads: the new page shows 'Reloaded this page: applied 2 held reloads' with focus on its sentence, never at the top of the document, and chat's draft and page context come back (FB-4, KEY-6, UNDO-2). Then the load says what devhost sees after web restarted: for a client that can show its state, 'Reloads are off: Bun's development script is gone from this page', a success that closes after O14's time and stays in the log (FB-6, FB-7); for Vite, which loads /@vite/client whatever server.hmr says, 'Request done · web restarted at 14:05 · Vite's client still loads, so devhost cannot tell whether reloads are off' with Show Changes and Dismiss, never Disable Reloads; after Dismiss, later loads of this stack and origin show no notice for that client until Show Reload Notice (UNDO-3, O24). A client that can show its state and still loads reads 'reloads are still on', with Disable Reloads leading. Per-client wording waits on fixtures (Backend 5). Resolves reload-and-agents-12 (each load said Vite hot reloading was on after server.hmr: false).

sources.label: Reuses: Bun's script seen in the page
Reuses: Vite seen from /@vite/client

nodes.label: Notice hidden, with Undo
nodes.explanation: Dismiss on the hot reload notice replaces it with 'Reload notice hidden' and Undo for O14's time, not counted while the pointer or focus is in it; Undo brings the notice back where it was with focus on Disable Reloads. Undo's accessible description says 'also in the Hold Reloads popover', where Show Reload Notice brings it back later, after a reload too: never a permanent hide (UNDO-3, FB-6, CC-20). The choice is kept per stack and page origin in this browser, never per worktree (SEL-11, CC-9). Resolves the permanent Dismiss of reload-and-agents-01.

sources.label: Replaces: Dismiss sets a saved flag
Replaces: dismissed flag kept for good

nodes.label: Send unavailable
nodes.explanation: When chat cannot take a message, the popover still shows the request with Copy and offers Hold Reloads; Send stays in place, focusable (aria-disabled), with one reason under it and as its accessible description (HOLD-5, MENU-3, HOLD-1): 'Chat is off in devhost.toml ([devtools.chat] enabled = false); running conversations stay reachable until they end', 'No coding agent found: devhost looks for codex and claude on devbox's PATH. Install one, then press Refresh Agents.', 'Lost connection to this conversation; reconnecting', or after a lost status stream 'Lost connection to devhost; retrying' (HOLD-2). A deleted worktree gives its reason with Return to Configured Worktree (HOLD-4, MENU-5); a rejected manifest blocks nothing (HOLD-6). When chat stops taking messages while the popover is open, it stays open with the edited request, Send unavailable in place and focus kept (KEY-11), as HOLD-5's clause for this popover says. A browser elsewhere that has not signed in reads 'Sign in with passkey or pair this browser to use devhost here' (HOLD-7, O36).

nodes.label: Request failed or stopped
nodes.explanation: A failed turn, a dead agent process or a failed delivery reads 'Request failed: Claude Code's turn ended with an error · 1 file changed before it stopped', a failure that stays across reloads until dismissed or a new request succeeds, with Disable Reloads leading, its popover reopening with the last edited text, then Show Changes and Open Conversation (FAIL-2, FAIL-3, FB-6, MENU-5); a repeat updates the same report with its count (FAIL-4). An unconfirmed delivery reads 'Delivery unconfirmed: Claude Code may not have the request' with Open Conversation and no way to resend (owner rule, REV-12). A turn the person stopped reads 'Request stopped by you after 29 s · 1 file changed' in the neutral style, never a failure, with Show Changes and Disable Reloads (FAIL-5, UNDO-4).

sources.label: Replaces: a failed send shows the plain notice

nodes.label: Hold off: 2 pending
nodes.explanation: Turning Hold Reloads off while reloads are held never reloads the page, because a toggle that reloads would discard a half-typed form: Reload blocked becomes '2 reloads pending' with Reload Now, and later script reloads go through; turning the hold on again holds again, and the pending count stays until a reload (UNDO-3, CC-20). Reload Now reloads once and reports 'Reloaded this page: applied 2 held reloads' (FB-4). The docs' 'Use Reload on the notice, or turn the hold off.' becomes 'Use Reload Now on the notice; after you turn the hold off, the held reload still waits for it.' (CC-20). Resolves reload-and-agents-03 (turning the hold off threw the held reload away and left the page stale, with nothing saying so).

sources.label: Replaces: hold off clears the held reload

nodes.label: Dismissed: 2 held shown
nodes.explanation: Dismiss on Reload blocked keeps the page as it is and leaves the held marker, '2 held', on Hold Reloads until a reload clears it, drawn with a shape of its own, never by color alone (SURF-8, UNDO-3, ACT-13); its accessible name reads 'Hold Reloads, on, 2 held', and its popover keeps the count with Reload Now. Collapsed, the badge carries the held reload: toolbar-shell's (toolbar-shell-01, related). A worktree switch names the held reloads in its question, 'Hold Reloads: 2 held reloads on this page are discarded by the switch', and its outcome says it discarded them (SEL-5, REV-3, FB-4; worktree-switch's). Resolves reload-and-agents-04 (after Dismiss, nothing showed that the page was out of date).

sources.label: Replaces: Dismiss clears the only held flag
Replaces: toggle that shows nothing held

nodes.label: A chat turn ends
nodes.explanation: Once a Disable Reloads result reports the change, reloads count as disabled for web in every browser of the stack, kept on the server with the request's record, and the Hold Reloads popover says so (O56, SEL-11, HOLD-8, CC-40). From then on devhost never reloads the page by itself after a chat turn: each later turn that changed files ends with 'Reload to see the change' and Reload Page, devhost's own reload through the hold, drawn by agent-chat in the turn's receipt (O56, FB-12, WORD-2). Before that, with Hold Reloads on, a turn that changed files and ends while this page holds reloads it caused applies them once as devhost's own reload, and the reloaded page shows 'Reloaded to show Claude Code's change', announced without moving focus; with focus in a text field, the page's or chat's composer, nothing reloads and Reload blocked says 'The page reload this change needs waits for you' with Reload Now (O57, UNDO-2, UNDO-3). Nothing reloads while a turn runs, and the request's own turn is never applied this way.

sources.label: Reuses: Hold Reloads on by default

cards.title: What changes versus today
items: Removed: the one-click send; opening chat, switching it to the Project directory and joining the one open conversation unnamed; the fixed request that names no setting; the worktree, commit and merge instructions on this request; hiding the notice while a request is tracked; settling only in the open conversation and the Project directory; the permanent Dismiss; dropping a held reload when the hold is turned off; the own-reload flag left set after a cancelled reload; Reload blocked's fixed 'Something tried to reload this page.'

Merged: the hot reload notice with the request's progress, waiting state and result in one notice slot; the Hold Reloads toggle, its held count, Reload Now and Show Reload Notice in one bar item with its popover

New: reloads recorded as disabled after a request's result, so later chat turns end with 'Reload to see the change' and Reload Page (O56); a chat turn's end applying this page's held reloads once, or waiting with Reload Now while the person types (O57); the popover with agent, model, conversation choice, approval line, mode line and the request per client; the no-verified-switch state; pending, waiting, stopped, unconfirmed and failed states with Open Conversation and Answer; the result with Restart web, Show Changes, Copy Reverse Patch and Ask to Undo; the request's record on the server, read by every browser of the stack; held counts, times, causes and changed files on Reload blocked; Already current; the held marker; pending reloads with Reload Now; Undo and Show Reload Notice; the outcome of a reload that applied held reloads; per-client knowledge from fixtures

Changed: Disable Reloads opens a popover instead of sending, and the request starts a new conversation unless the person picks one (CC-15, O27); the notice shows the request's state across reloads instead of hiding; a failed request shows its result with Disable Reloads; the request settles from its own conversation in any directory; the request names the client's switch; turning the hold off keeps a held reload pending with Reload Now (CC-20); dismissing Reload blocked leaves the held marker; Dismiss is reversible (CC-20); Hold Reloads becomes a popover trigger; the words say reloads, not hot reloading (CC-31); the choices are kept per stack and page origin (CC-9)

Kept: Hold Reloads on by default, with no agent and no change to the worktree's files, holding any dev server's location.reload(), server restarts included, without patching the page; the browser's refresh and devhost's own reloads never held, and the notice's reload, now Reload Now, applying held reloads in one press; hot module replacement never held; detection of Bun, Vite, Next.js and webpack, meaning only that the client loaded, shown only with chat on; no page context in the request; no open conversation receiving it unchosen; a failed or cancelled send bringing back the way to ask again; no second request while one is pending; Delivery unconfirmed and no resend; devhost never answering or pre-approving the agent; the server resolving the worktree from the routed service, checking each send and keeping the 8 MiB limit; the hold also holding the app's own location.reload(), only where the Navigation API exists; devhost restarting nothing by itself

cards.title: Tickets this journey resolves
items: Notice, popover, send and Dismiss: reload-and-agents-01 (P1)
Request followed in its own conversation: reload-and-agents-08, reload-and-agents-11
Result and the next load: reload-and-agents-02, reload-and-agents-12
Reload blocked: journey-agent-fix-03 (slice: whether the page is already current; the rest: services-panel), with its duplicate stack-scale-08
Hold Reloads and held reloads: reload-and-agents-03, reload-and-agents-04, reload-and-agents-07

Related, not covered: chat-compose-04, keyboard-and-screen-reader-04, toolbar-shell-01, toolbar-shell-03 and toolbar-shell-07 (toolbar-shell); keyboard-and-screen-reader-02 (notices-and-feedback); services-panel-2-01 (services-panel)

cards.title: Backend work
items: The request's send carries mode: 'live' and the live mode's instructions, never the worktree workflow; agent-chat builds it, and its prompt stopgap ships the live text first (CC-10). Required
The request followed by its sessionId and commandId in its own conversation: every session of the stack listed and a delivery record per send in the journal; no new route (CC-38, CC-40). Required
The turn's changed files and the reverse patch of the agent's own edits, from the journal, with no Git command (O22; agent-chat builds it). Required
The page's service, its launch time and its changed files in the published state (CC-25, CC-6; services-panel builds it). Required

Per-client fixtures (Bun, Vite, Next.js, webpack-dev-server) before and after each switch and a restart decide which clients can show their state and when Already current applies; the notice's claims follow O24. Required before the per-client wording ships
Verified switches for Next.js and webpack; until then they get O25's state. Recommended
devhost's own reload passes exactly one navigation, so a reload cancelled at 'Leave site?' leaves the hold holding (browser code only). Required

The request's record and reloads disabled kept on the server with the conversation's delivery record, read by every browser of the stack, and the per-turn held count a turn's end applies (O56, O57, CC-38, CC-40). Required

cards.title: Contract changes
items: CC-15: Disable Reloads opens a popover naming the agent and showing the editable request, scoped to this worktree; Hold Reloads is the way without an agent; the devtools AGENTS.md paragraph no longer selects the project target or hides the notice while a request runs
CC-20: Dismiss is undone with Undo or Show Reload Notice; turning the hold off keeps a held reload pending with Reload Now
CC-31: the docs say a page's dev server reloads it, not that it is served with hot reloading
CC-32: CONTEXT.md gains Reloads
CC-45 (REV-5, FB-5, O24, O27, SEL-11): the docs' Disable Reloads paragraph, its client note, the Hold Reloads storage line, and the O56 sentence on later turns
Depends on: CC-9, CC-10, CC-14, CC-38 and CC-40 (agent-chat); CC-6, CC-25 and CC-37 (services-panel); CC-1 and CC-3 (toolbar-shell)
